_comment: Bowtruckles guard wand-wood trees and will lead a wandmaker to good wood for a woodlouse. The gift is the whole point of bonding one: a wandwood sapling is otherwise found only by chopping down the tree it came from.
_breedingComment: Bowtruckles nest in a wand-wood tree in colonies, so a grove that has been fed for long enough gets more of them. Gated on the same mallowsweet as the top feed and behind a higher bond than the mooncalf: a wandwood supply that reproduces needs to be earned.
